name: skillsmith
description: Author and audit Claude skills: concise structure, progressive disclosure, degrees of freedom, honest compliance framing, and a per-seam audit — each lens an independent auditor — that finds token waste, duplication, costly subagent usage, and dead skills, plus an opt-in behavioral seam that pressure-tests whether a skill is actually discovered, read, and followed. Use when writing, editing, evaluating, optimizing, hardening, or pruning a skill.
